summary: A solid Dynamo-style single-region KV store with tunable quorums (N/R/W), SWIM gossip + consistent hashing/vnodes, and LSM-backed storage with hinted handoff, read repair, and anti-entropy. It is largely production-shaped (ops, security, backups) and correctly embraces eventual consistency with explicit conflict surfacing via causal context.
strengths: Covers the core Dynamo mechanics end-to-end (quorums, hinted handoff, read repair, Merkle-based anti-entropy) with clear failure-mode intent and operational hooks
Pragmatic storage/ops choices (embedded LSM with WAL, throttled repairs, AZ-aware replica placement, security and backup considerations) that map well to real deployments
weaknesses: Some critical edge details are underspecified: membership/ring-change correctness during reads/writes, partition handling semantics, backpressure/retry strategy under overload, and precise delete/tombstone GC guarantees

Capacity/cost and correctness trade-offs need tighter reasoning (IO/compaction amplification at stated QPS, cross-AZ quorum latency/cost, sibling-cap behavior and potential data loss, in-memory idempotency cache behavior across coordinator restarts)
